full_name: Mercedes López-Morales | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Mercedes López-Morales is an astrophysicst at the Harvard–Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics (CfA), where she works on the discovery and characterization of exoplanets. She joined the CfA staff in 2012.
